long_biography.plain_text:
A street in Istanbul's Bayrampaşa district now bears Arda Turan's name, marking the neighbourhood where he grew up and first played organised football. He moved from local club Altıntepsi into Galatasaray's academy at eleven, then developed the technique and leadership that took him from Istanbul to Spain.

Turan has carried that football education into management. At Shakhtar Donetsk, he emphasises tactical discipline, intensive training and opportunities for young players while leading a club displaced from its Donetsk home. His first season brought the Ukrainian league title and a Conference League semi-final, giving the former midfielder an immediate foothold in European coaching.
